	countdownSound,

	innocentTpSound,
	innocentTickSound,
}

local function playManagedSound(soundObj)
	if not soundsEnabled or not soundObj then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		soundObj.TimePosition = 0
		soundObj:Play()
	end)
end

local function playSecondTickSound()
	playManagedSound(countdownSound)
end

local function playWinnerTickSound()
	playManagedSound(winnerTickSound)
end

local function playInnocentTpSound()
	playManagedSound(innocentTpSound)
end

local function playInnocentTickSound()
	playManagedSound(innocentTickSound)
end

local function applySoundsStateToAll()
	if not soundsEnabled then
		for _, snd in ipairs(allScriptSounds) do
			pcall(function()
				snd:Stop()
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Salvataggio spawnpoint iniziale per GOTO LOBBY e INNOCENT SAFETY
local initialLobbyCFrame = nil
local function captureInitialLobbySpawn(char)
	if initialLobbyCFrame then
		return
	end
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		initialLobbyCFrame = root.CFrame
	end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
	captureInitialLobbySpawn(LocalPlayer.Character)
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if root and not initialLobbyCFrame then
		initialLobbyCFrame = root.CFrame
	end
end)

local function getLobbySpawnDestination()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not initialLobbyCFrame and root then
		initialLobbyCFrame = root.CFrame
	end
	local spawnPart = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation", true)
	return initialLobbyCFrame or (spawnPart and spawnPart:IsA("BasePart") and (spawnPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)))
end

	btn.LayoutOrder = layoutOrder
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.940, 0, 0, 30)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.Active = true
	btn.Selectable = true
	btn.FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/SourceSansPro.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
	btn.Parent = parentFrame

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = btn

	local constraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
	constraint.MaxTextSize = 14
	constraint.MinTextSize = 9
	constraint.Parent = btn
end

	soundsEnabled = state
	if soundsEnabled then
		SoundsToggle.Text = "SOUNDS: ON"
		SoundsToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)
	else
		SoundsToggle.Text = "SOUNDS: OFF"
		SoundsToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		applySoundsStateToAll()
	end
end

setSoundsState(true)

	setSoundsState(not soundsEnabled)
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 0. LOGICA FLY JUMP&NOCLIP (INSTANT UPWARD FLIGHT SPEED 20 + NORMAL GRAVITY)
-- =========================================================================
local flyJumpNoclipEnabled = false
local noclipConn = nil
local jumpInputConn = nil
local flyUpConn = nil
local jumpHeld = false

local FLY_UP_SPEED = 20

local function stopFlyJumpNoclip()
	if noclipConn then
		noclipConn:Disconnect()
		noclipConn = nil
	end
	if jumpInputConn then
		jumpInputConn:Disconnect()
		jumpInputConn = nil
	end
	if flyUpConn then
		flyUpConn:Disconnect()
		flyUpConn = nil
	end
	jumpHeld = false

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.CanCollide = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setFlyJumpNoclipState(state)
	flyJumpNoclipEnabled = state
	if flyJumpNoclipEnabled then
		FlyJumpNoclipToggle.Text = "FLY JUMP&NOCLIP: ON"
		FlyJumpNoclipToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)

		stopFlyJumpNoclip()

		noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			if not flyJumpNoclipEnabled then
				return
			end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			if char then
				for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") then
						p.CanCollide = false
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		jumpInputConn = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
			if not flyJumpNoclipEnabled then
				return
			end
			jumpHeld = true
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hum then
				hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			end
			if root then
				local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				if vel.Y < FLY_UP_SPEED then
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FLY_UP_SPEED, vel.Z)
				end
			end
		end)

		flyUpConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if not flyJumpNoclipEnabled then
				return
			end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not char or not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
				jumpHeld = false
				return
			end

			local isJumpingNow = hum.Jump or jumpHeld or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
			if isJumpingNow then
				local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				-- Applica velocità 20 verso l'alto senza bloccare la caduta quando lasci il salto
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, math.max(vel.Y, FLY_UP_SPEED), vel.Z)
				jumpHeld = false
			end
		end)
	else
		FlyJumpNoclipToggle.Text = "FLY JUMP&NOCLIP: OFF"
		FlyJumpNoclipToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		stopFlyJumpNoclip()
	end
end

FlyJumpNoclipToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setFlyJumpNoclipState(not flyJumpNoclipEnabled)
end)
-- ==========================================
-- 1. LOGICA ESP GIOCATORI (ZERO LOOP PESANTI)
-- ==========================================
local COLOR_GUN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)   -- Blu
local COLOR_KNIFE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40) -- Rosso
local COLOR_OTHER = Color3.fromRGB(40, 255, 90) -- Verde

local espEnabled = false
local playerConnections = {}
local globalConnections = {}

local function checkContainerForRole(container)
	if not container then
		return nil
	end
	local hasKnife = false
	for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then
			local lowerName = string.lower(item.Name)
			if lowerName == "gun" then
				return COLOR_GUN
			elseif lowerName == "knife" then
				hasKnife = true
			end
		end
	end
	if hasKnife then
		return COLOR_KNIFE
	end
	return nil
end

local function getEspColor(player)
	local charColor = checkContainerForRole(player.Character)
	if charColor == COLOR_GUN then
		return COLOR_GUN
	end

	local bagColor = checkContainerForRole(player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
	if bagColor == COLOR_GUN then
		return COLOR_GUN
	end

	if charColor == COLOR_KNIFE or bagColor == COLOR_KNIFE then
		return COLOR_KNIFE
	end

	return COLOR_OTHER
end

local function updatePlayerEsp(player)
	if not espEnabled or player == LocalPlayer then
		return
	end

	local char = player.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not char or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		if char then
			local old = char:FindFirstChild("Remawed10_ESP")
			if old then
				old:Destroy()
			end
		end
		return
	end

	local highlight = char:FindFirstChild("Remawed10_ESP")
	if not highlight then
		highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "Remawed10_ESP"
		highlight.Adornee = char
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.50
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.1
		highlight.Parent = char
	end

	local targetColor = getEspColor(player)
	if highlight.FillColor ~= targetColor then
		highlight.FillColor = targetColor
		highlight.OutlineColor = targetColor
	end
end

local function disconnectPlayer(player)
	local conns = playerConnections[player]
	if conns then
		for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
			conn:Disconnect()
		end
		playerConnections[player] = nil
	end
end

local function bindPlayer(player)
	if player == LocalPlayer then
		return
	end
	disconnectPlayer(player)

	local conns = {}
	playerConnections[player] = conns

	local function hookBackpack(backpack)
		if not backpack then
			return
		end
		table.insert(conns, backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
			updatePlayerEsp(player)
		end))
		table.insert(conns, backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
			updatePlayerEsp(player)
		end))
	end

	local function hookCharacter(char)
		if not char then
			return
		end
		table.insert(conns, char.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
			updatePlayerEsp(player)
		end))
		table.insert(conns, char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
			updatePlayerEsp(player)
		end))
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			table.insert(conns, hum.Died:Connect(function()
				updatePlayerEsp(player)
			end))
		end
		updatePlayerEsp(player)
	end

	hookBackpack(player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
	hookCharacter(player.Character)

	table.insert(conns, player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child:IsA("Backpack") then
			hookBackpack(child)
			updatePlayerEsp(player)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(conns, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.wait(0.1)
		hookCharacter(char)
	end))
end

local function clearAllPlayerEsp()
	for _, conn in ipairs(globalConnections) do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(globalConnections)

	for player, _ in pairs(playerConnections) do
		disconnectPlayer(player)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local existing = char:FindFirstChild("Remawed10_ESP")
			if existing then
				existing:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setEspState(state)
	espEnabled = state
	if espEnabled then
		EspToggle.Text = "ESP: ON"
		EspToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			bindPlayer(player)
		end

		table.insert(globalConnections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
			bindPlayer(player)
		end))

		table.insert(globalConnections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
			disconnectPlayer(player)
		end))
	else
		EspToggle.Text = "ESP: OFF"
		EspToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		clearAllPlayerEsp()
	end
end

EspToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setEspState(not espEnabled)
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 2. LOGICA ESP COIN ("Coin_Server" COME MODELLO CON FIGLI GIALLI, 21ms)
-- =========================================================================
local COLOR_COIN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 0) -- Giallo
local COIN_MAX_DISTANCE = 100 -- Raggio massimo in studs
local POOL_SIZE = 12          -- Pool fisso riutilizzabile
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.021 -- Aggiornamento ogni 21 millisecondi

local espCoinEnabled = false
local coinAddedConn = nil
local coinRemovedConn = nil
local coinUpdateThread = nil

local coinCache = {}
local hlPool = {}

local function resolveCoinModelAndPart(obj)
	if not obj or obj.Name ~= "Coin_Server" then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		local part = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		if part then
			return obj, part
		end
	elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		local parentModel = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if parentModel and parentModel ~= workspace then
			return parentModel, obj
		end
		return obj, obj
	end
	return nil, nil
end

local function ensurePool()
	if #hlPool > 0 then
		return
	end
	for i = 1, POOL_SIZE do
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = "Remawed10_CoinModelPool_" .. i
		hl.Enabled = false
		hl.Adornee = nil
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.FillColor = COLOR_COIN
		hl.OutlineColor = COLOR_COIN
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.45
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.Parent = ScreenGui
		table.insert(hlPool, hl)
	end
end

local function disablePool()
	for _, hl in ipairs(hlPool) do
		hl.Enabled = false
		hl.Adornee = nil
	end
end

local function stepCoinModelEsp()
	if not espCoinEnabled then
		return
	end

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		disablePool()
		return
	end

	local rootPos = root.Position
	local maxDistSq = COIN_MAX_DISTANCE * COIN_MAX_DISTANCE
	local candidates = {}

	for coinObj, data in pairs(coinCache) do
		local modelTarget = data.modelTarget
		local anchorPart = data.anchorPart
		if not coinObj.Parent or not modelTarget or not modelTarget.Parent or not anchorPart or not anchorPart.Parent then
			coinCache[coinObj] = nil
		else
			local dx = anchorPart.Position.X - rootPos.X
			local dy = anchorPart.Position.Y - rootPos.Y
			local dz = anchorPart.Position.Z - rootPos.Z
			local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
			if distSq <= maxDistSq then
				table.insert(candidates, { target = modelTarget, distSq = distSq })
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
		return a.distSq < b.distSq
	end)

	local count = math.min(#candidates, POOL_SIZE)
	for i = 1, POOL_SIZE do
		local hl = hlPool[i]
		if hl then
			if i <= count then
				local target = candidates[i].target
				if hl.Adornee ~= target then
					hl.Adornee = target
				end
				if not hl.Enabled then
					hl.Enabled = true
				end
			else
				if hl.Enabled then
					hl.Enabled = false
				end
				if hl.Adornee ~= nil then
					hl.Adornee = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function clearAllCoinEsp()
	if coinAddedConn then
		coinAddedConn:Disconnect()
		coinAddedConn = nil
	end
	if coinRemovedConn then
		coinRemovedConn:Disconnect()
		coinRemovedConn = nil
	end
	if coinUpdateThread then
		task.cancel(coinUpdateThread)
		coinUpdateThread = nil
	end
	disablePool()
	table.clear(coinCache)
end

local function setEspCoinState(state)
	espCoinEnabled = state
	if espCoinEnabled then
		EspCoinToggle.Text = "ESP COIN: ON"
		EspCoinToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(185, 155, 0)

		ensurePool()
		table.clear(coinCache)

		for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc.Name == "Coin_Server" then
				local modelTarget, anchorPart = resolveCoinModelAndPart(desc)
				if modelTarget and anchorPart then
					coinCache[desc] = { modelTarget = modelTarget, anchorPart = anchorPart }
				end
			end
		end

		coinAddedConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
			if espCoinEnabled and desc.Name == "Coin_Server" then
				local modelTarget, anchorPart = resolveCoinModelAndPart(desc)
				if modelTarget and anchorPart then
					coinCache[desc] = { modelTarget = modelTarget, anchorPart = anchorPart }
				end
			end
		end)

		coinRemovedConn = workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(desc)
			if coinCache[desc] then
				coinCache[desc] = nil
			end
		end)

		coinUpdateThread = task.spawn(function()
			while espCoinEnabled do
				stepCoinModelEsp()
				task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
			end
		end)
	else
		EspCoinToggle.Text = "ESP COIN: OFF"
		EspCoinToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		clearAllCoinEsp()
	end
end

EspCoinToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setEspCoinState(not espCoinEnabled)
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 3. LOGICA LOAD FLY GUI (PULSANTE SINGOLO)
-- =========================================================================
LoadFlyGuiButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Remastfe10/REMAWED10/refs/heads/main/fly%20gui%20fixed.txt"))()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Errore Load Fly GUI:", err)
	end
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 4. LOGICA AUTO KILL MURDERER (HUMANOID + MIRA SOPRA + DISTANTE + NO BUG CAM)
-- =========================================================================
local autoKillEnabled = false
local autoKillThread = nil
local activeFollowTargetRoot = nil
local isChaseActive = false

local BACK_DISTANCE = 8.5
local AIM_ABOVE_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
local FOLLOW_STEP_INTERVAL = 0.03
local RENDER_BIND_NAME = "Remawed10_MurdererCleanAim"

local function findLocalGunTool()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(item.Name) == "gun" then
				return item
			end
		end
	end
	local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(item.Name) == "gun" then
				return item
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function hasKnifeInContainer(container)
	if not container then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(item.Name) == "knife" then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function findAliveMurderer()
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
			local char = plr.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if char and hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
				local backpack = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
				if hasKnifeInContainer(char) or hasKnifeInContainer(backpack) then
					return plr, char, root, hum
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, nil, nil, nil
end

local function bindCleanAimAndBackFollow()
	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(RENDER_BIND_NAME)
	end)

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(RENDER_BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
		if not autoKillEnabled or not isChaseActive then
			return
		end

		local targetRoot = activeFollowTargetRoot
		if not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then
			return
		end

		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not myChar or not myRoot or not myHum or myHum.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		local flatBackVec = Vector3.new(-targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, -targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
		if flatBackVec.Magnitude < 0.01 then
			flatBackVec = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		else
			flatBackVec = flatBackVec.Unit
		end

		local backPos = targetRoot.Position + (flatBackVec * BACK_DISTANCE)
		local aimPoint = targetRoot.Position + AIM_ABOVE_OFFSET

		if (myRoot.Position - backPos).Magnitude > 16 then
			myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(backPos)
		end

		myHum:MoveTo(backPos)

		local flatAimTarget = Vector3.new(aimPoint.X, myRoot.Position.Y, aimPoint.Z)
		if (flatAimTarget - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myRoot.Position, flatAimTarget)
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom then
			local currentOffset = camera.CFrame.Position - aimPoint
			local dist = math.clamp(currentOffset.Magnitude, 7, 16)
			local dir = currentOffset.Magnitude > 0.01 and currentOffset.Unit or (flatBackVec + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)).Unit
			local desiredCamPos = aimPoint + (dir * dist)
			camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(desiredCamPos, aimPoint)
		end
	end)
end

local function unbindCleanAimAndBackFollow()
	isChaseActive = false
	activeFollowTargetRoot = nil
	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(RENDER_BIND_NAME)
	end)
end

local function runAutoKillSequence()
	local countdownDone = false
	local lastSoundTime = 0

	while autoKillEnabled do
		local gunTool = findLocalGunTool()
		local _, targetChar, targetRoot, targetHum = findAliveMurderer()

		if not gunTool or not targetChar or not targetRoot or not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
			countdownDone = false
			isChaseActive = false
			activeFollowTargetRoot = nil
			setWarningNotification(false)
			task.wait(0.15)
		else
			if not countdownDone then
				isChaseActive = false
				for remaining = 5, 1, -1 do
					if not autoKillEnabled or not findLocalGunTool() then
						setWarningNotification(false)
						return
					end
					setWarningNotification(true, remaining)
					playSecondTickSound()
					lastSoundTime = os.clock()

					local elapsed = 0
					while elapsed < 1 and autoKillEnabled do
						local step = math.min(0.1, 1 - elapsed)
						task.wait(step)
						elapsed += step
					end
				end
				setWarningNotification(false)
				countdownDone = true
			end

			local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
			local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if myChar and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 and targetRoot.Parent and targetHum.Health > 0 then
				if gunTool.Parent ~= myChar then
					myHum:EquipTool(gunTool)
				end

				activeFollowTargetRoot = targetRoot
				isChaseActive = true

				local now = os.clock()
				if now - lastSoundTime >= 1 then
					playSecondTickSound()
					lastSoundTime = now
				end
			else
				isChaseActive = false
			end

			task.wait(FOLLOW_STEP_INTERVAL)
		end
	end

	unbindCleanAimAndBackFollow()
	setWarningNotification(false)
end

local function setAutoKillState(state)
	autoKillEnabled = state
	if autoKillEnabled then
		AutoKillMurdererToggle.Text = "Auto kill murderer: ON"
		AutoKillMurdererToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)

		bindCleanAimAndBackFollow()
		if not autoKillThread then
			autoKillThread = task.spawn(function()
				runAutoKillSequence()
				autoKillThread = nil
			end)
		end
	else
		AutoKillMurdererToggle.Text = "Auto kill murderer: OFF"
		AutoKillMurdererToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		unbindCleanAimAndBackFollow()
		setWarningNotification(false)
		if autoKillThread then
			task.cancel(autoKillThread)
			autoKillThread = nil
		end
	end
end

AutoKillMurdererToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setAutoKillState(not autoKillEnabled)
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 5. LOGICA AUTO KILLER WINNER (KNIFE ONLY + 5s ORANGE + SKIP + FINALBOS 3s)
-- =========================================================================
local winnerEnabled = false
local winnerThread = nil

local WINNER_MAX_DISTANCE = 600
local WINNER_BACK_STICK_DIST = 2.2
local WINNER_STEP_INTERVAL = 0.03

local function findLocalKnifeTool()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(item.Name) == "knife" then
				return item
			end
		end
	end
	local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
			if item:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(item.Name) == "knife" then
				return item
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function hasGunInContainer(container)
	if not container then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") and string.lower(item.Name) == "gun" then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function playerHasGun(plr)
	if not plr then
		return false
	end
	local backpack = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return hasGunInContainer(plr.Character) or hasGunInContainer(backpack)
end

local function isTargetValidInRange(plr, myRoot)
	if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer or not myRoot or not myRoot.Parent then
		return false, nil, nil, nil
	end
	local char = plr.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not char or not hum or not root or not root.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then
		return false, nil, nil, nil
	end
	local dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
	if dist > WINNER_MAX_DISTANCE then
		return false, nil, nil, nil
	end
	return true, char, root, hum
end

local function collectNearbyAliveTargets(myRoot)
	local targets = {}
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local ok, char, root, hum = isTargetValidInRange(plr, myRoot)
		if ok then
			table.insert(targets, {
				player = plr,
				character = char,
				root = root,
				humanoid = hum,
				hasGun = playerHasGun(plr),
				dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude,
			})
		end
	end

	table.sort(targets, function(a, b)
		if a.hasGun ~= b.hasGun then
			return not a.hasGun
		end
		return a.dist < b.dist
	end)

	return targets
end

local function stickBehindPlayer(myChar, myRoot, myHum, targetRoot)
	if not myChar or not myRoot or not myHum or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then
		return
	end

	local flatBackVec = Vector3.new(-targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, -targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if flatBackVec.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		flatBackVec = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		flatBackVec = flatBackVec.Unit
	end

	local stickPos = targetRoot.Position + (flatBackVec * WINNER_BACK_STICK_DIST)
	local lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, myRoot.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)

	if (myRoot.Position - stickPos).Magnitude > 10 then
		myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(stickPos, lookTarget)
	else
		myHum:MoveTo(stickPos)
		if (lookTarget - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then
			myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myRoot.Position, lookTarget)
		end
	end
end

local function runWinnerCountdown(secondsCount, prefixText, currentTargetName)
	for remaining = secondsCount, 1, -1 do
		if not winnerEnabled or not findLocalKnifeTool() then
			setWinnerHud(false)
			return false
		end
		if skipRequested then
			skipRequested = false
			return true
		end

		local labelText = currentTargetName and string.format("%s %ds [%s]", prefixText, remaining, currentTargetName)
			or string.format("%s %ds", prefixText, remaining)
		setWinnerHud(true, labelText)
		playWinnerTickSound()

		local elapsed = 0
		while elapsed < 1 and winnerEnabled do
			if skipRequested then
				skipRequested = false
				return true
			end
			if not findLocalKnifeTool() then
				setWinnerHud(false)
				return false
			end
			local step = math.min(0.1, 1 - elapsed)
			task.wait(step)
			elapsed += step
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function runAutoKillerWinnerSequence()
	local initialCountdownDone = false
	local finalBossTriggered = {}

	while winnerEnabled do
		local knifeTool = findLocalKnifeTool()
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if not knifeTool or not myChar or not myRoot or not myHum or myHum.Health <= 0 then
			initialCountdownDone = false
			setWinnerHud(false)
			task.wait(0.15)
		else
			if not initialCountdownDone then
				local ok = runWinnerCountdown(5, "you will go kill everyone between:", nil)
				if not ok then
					setWinnerHud(false)
					return
				end
				initialCountdownDone = true
			end

			local targets = collectNearbyAliveTargets(myRoot)
			if #targets == 0 then
				setWinnerHud(true, "you will go kill everyone between: waiting nearby targets...")
				task.wait(0.2)
			else
				local entry = targets[1]
				local targetPlr = entry.player
				local targetRoot = entry.root
				local targetHum = entry.humanoid

				local onlyGunTargetLeft = (entry.hasGun and #targets == 1)
				if onlyGunTargetLeft and not finalBossTriggered[targetPlr] then
					finalBossTriggered[targetPlr] = true
					local bossOk = runWinnerCountdown(3, "FINALBOS IN", targetPlr.Name)
					if not bossOk then
						setWinnerHud(false)
						return
					end
				end

				while winnerEnabled do
					skipRequested = false
					knifeTool = findLocalKnifeTool()
					myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
					myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if not knifeTool or not myChar or not myRoot or not myHum or myHum.Health <= 0 then
						break
					end

					local stillValid, _, freshRoot, freshHum = isTargetValidInRange(targetPlr, myRoot)
					if not stillValid or not freshRoot or not freshHum or freshHum.Health <= 0 then
						break
					end

					if knifeTool.Parent ~= myChar then
						myHum:EquipTool(knifeTool)
					end

					setWinnerHud(true, onlyGunTargetLeft and ("FINALBOS - " .. targetPlr.Name) or ("KILLING: " .. targetPlr.Name))
					stickBehindPlayer(myChar, myRoot, myHum, freshRoot)

					task.wait(WINNER_STEP_INTERVAL)
					if skipRequested then
						skipRequested = false
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	setWinnerHud(false)
end

local function setAutoKillerWinnerState(state)
	winnerEnabled = state
	skipRequested = false
	if winnerEnabled then
		AutoKillerWinnerToggle.Text = "Auto killer winner: ON"
		AutoKillerWinnerToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)

		if not winnerThread then
			winnerThread = task.spawn(function()
				runAutoKillerWinnerSequence()
				winnerThread = nil
			end)
		end
	else
		AutoKillerWinnerToggle.Text = "Auto killer winner: OFF"
		AutoKillerWinnerToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		setWinnerHud(false)
		if winnerThread then
			task.cancel(winnerThread)
			winnerThread = nil
		end
	end
end

AutoKillerWinnerToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setAutoKillerWinnerState(not winnerEnabled)
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 6. LOGICA GOTO LOBBY (PULSANTE SINGOLO VERSO SPAWNPOINT INIZIALE)
-- =========================================================================
GotoLobbyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		return
	end

	local destination = getLobbySpawnDestination()
	if destination then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.CFrame = destination
	end
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 7. LOGICA XRAY ULTRA (TUTTE LE PART SEMI-TRASPARENTI E BIANCHE FINO A OFF)
-- =========================================================================
local xrayUltraEnabled = false
local xraySavedParts = {}
local xrayAddedConn = nil

local XRAY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local XRAY_MODIFIER = 0.65

local function isPlayerCharacterDescendant(obj)
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function applyXrayToPart(part)
	if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if isPlayerCharacterDescendant(part) then
		return
	end
	if xraySavedParts[part] == nil then
		xraySavedParts[part] = {
			Color = part.Color,
			LocalTransparencyModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
		}
	end
	part.Color = XRAY_COLOR
	part.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.max(part.LocalTransparencyModifier, XRAY_MODIFIER)
end

local function restoreAllXrayParts()
	for part, saved in pairs(xraySavedParts) do
		if part and part.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				part.Color = saved.Color
				part.LocalTransparencyModifier = saved.LocalTransparencyModifier
			end)
		end
	end
	table.clear(xraySavedParts)
end

local function setXrayUltraState(state)
	xrayUltraEnabled = state
	if xrayUltraEnabled then
		XrayUltraToggle.Text = "XRAY ULTRA: ON"
		XrayUltraToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)

		for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				applyXrayToPart(desc)
			end
		end

		if not xrayAddedConn then
			xrayAddedConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
				if xrayUltraEnabled and desc:IsA("BasePart") then
					applyXrayToPart(desc)
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		XrayUltraToggle.Text = "XRAY ULTRA: OFF"
		XrayUltraToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		if xrayAddedConn then
			xrayAddedConn:Disconnect()
			xrayAddedConn = nil
		end
		restoreAllXrayParts()
	end
end

XrayUltraToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setXrayUltraState(not xrayUltraEnabled)
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- 8. LOGICA SAFETY: INNOCENT SAFETY (COPERTURA REALE + NO VICINANZA + 2s VOLO)
-- =========================================================================
local innocentSafetyEnabled = false
local innocentSafetyThread = nil
local innocentActiveEscape = false

local INNOCENT_HOLD_SECONDS = 15
local INNOCENT_CHECK_INTERVAL = 0.05
local AIR_GRACE_SECONDS = 2.0

local airborneSince = nil

local function isCharacterGrounded(hum, root)
	if not hum or not root then
		return true
	end
	if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
		return true
	end
	local state = hum:GetState()
	if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function isFlyingForTwoSeconds(myHum, myRoot)
	local now = os.clock()
	if isCharacterGrounded(myHum, myRoot) then
		airborneSince = nil
		return false
	end

	if airborneSince == nil then
		airborneSince = now
		return false
	end

	return (now - airborneSince) >= AIR_GRACE_SECONDS
end

local function containerHasKnifeOrGun(container)
	if not container then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Tool") then
			local lowerName = string.lower(item.Name)
			if lowerName == "knife" or lowerName == "gun" then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function localHasKnifeOrGun()
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return containerHasKnifeOrGun(char) or containerHasKnifeOrGun(backpack)
end

local function playerHasKnifeTool(plr)
	if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then
		return false
	end
	local char = plr.Character
	local backpack = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return hasKnifeInContainer(char) or hasKnifeInContainer(backpack)
end

local function isTransparentOrGlass(part)
	if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false
	end
	if part.Transparency >= 0.65 then
		return true
	end
	local lowerName = string.lower(part.Name)
	if string.find(lowerName, "mirror", 1, true)
		or string.find(lowerName, "glass", 1, true)
		or string.find(lowerName, "window", 1, true) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function hasDirectUncoveredLine(threatPos, protectedPos, threatChar, protectedChar)
	local vector = protectedPos - threatPos
	if vector.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
		return true
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local ignoreList = {}
	if threatChar then
		table.insert(ignoreList, threatChar)
	end
	if protectedChar then
		table.insert(ignoreList, protectedChar)
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local origin = threatPos
	local remaining = vector

	for _ = 1, 4 do
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, remaining, params)
		if not hit then
			return true
		end

		local hitPart = hit.Instance
		if protectedChar and hitPart and hitPart:IsDescendantOf(protectedChar) then
			return true
		end

		if hitPart and hitPart:IsA("BasePart") and hitPart.CanCollide and not isTransparentOrGlass(hitPart) then
			return false
		end

		local dir = remaining.Unit
		origin = hit.Position + (dir * 0.1)
		remaining = protectedPos - origin
		if remaining.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function findThreateningKnifePlayer(myChar, myRoot)
	if not myChar or not myRoot then
		return nil
	end

	local myHum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not myHum or myHum.Health <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local myHead = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local myCenter = myRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)
	local myTop = (myHead and myHead.Position) or (myRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.9, 0))

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= LocalPlayer and playerHasKnifeTool(plr) then
			local tChar = plr.Character
			local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local tHead = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("Head")

			if tChar and tHum and tRoot and tHum.Health > 0 then
				local tEye = (tHead and tHead.Position) or (tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
				local tMid = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)

				if hasDirectUncoveredLine(tEye, myCenter, tChar, myChar)
					or hasDirectUncoveredLine(tEye, myTop, tChar, myChar)
					or hasDirectUncoveredLine(tMid, myCenter, tChar, myChar) then
					return plr
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function teleportRootToCFrame(root, cf)
	if not root or not root.Parent or not cf then
		return
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.CFrame = cf
end

local function runInnocentEscapeCountdown(savedReturnCFrame, threatName)
	innocentActiveEscape = true
	innocentSkipRequested = false
	setFlightAlertVisible(false)
	InnocentGui.Enabled = true
	playInnocentTpSound()

	local skipped = false
	local elapsedTotal = 0

	for remaining = INNOCENT_HOLD_SECONDS, 1, -1 do
		if not innocentSafetyEnabled then
			break
		end
		if innocentSkipRequested then
			innocentSkipRequested = false
			skipped = true
			break
		end

		InnocentLabel.Text = string.format("INNOCENT SAFETY [%s]! Return in: %ds", threatName or "KNIFE", remaining)
		playInnocentTickSound()

		local secElapsed = 0
		while secElapsed < 1 and innocentSafetyEnabled do
			if innocentSkipRequested then
				innocentSkipRequested = false
				skipped = true
				break
			end

			local flashAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(elapsedTotal * 14)
			InnocentFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 6, 6):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(165, 14, 14), flashAlpha)
			InnocentStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 160), flashAlpha)
			InnocentIcon.TextTransparency = flashAlpha > 0.5 and 0 or 0.35

			local step = math.min(0.05, 1 - secElapsed)
			task.wait(step)
			secElapsed += step
			elapsedTotal += step
		end

		if skipped then
			break
		end
	end

	InnocentGui.Enabled = false
	InnocentIcon.TextTransparency = 0
	innocentActiveEscape = false

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if innocentSafetyEnabled and root and savedReturnCFrame then
		teleportRootToCFrame(root, savedReturnCFrame)
		airborneSince = os.clock()
	end
end

local function runInnocentSafetyLoop()
	airborneSince = nil

	while innocentSafetyEnabled do
		local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
		local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if not innocentActiveEscape and myChar and myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0 then
			local flying2s = isFlyingForTwoSeconds(myHum, myRoot)
			setFlightAlertVisible(flying2s)

			if not flying2s and not localHasKnifeOrGun() then
				local threatPlr = findThreateningKnifePlayer(myChar, myRoot)
				local spawnDest = getLobbySpawnDestination()
				if threatPlr and spawnDest then
					local returnCFrame = myRoot.CFrame
					teleportRootToCFrame(myRoot, spawnDest)
					runInnocentEscapeCountdown(returnCFrame, threatPlr.Name)
					task.wait(1.0)
				end
			end
		else
			setFlightAlertVisible(false)
		end

		task.wait(INNOCENT_CHECK_INTERVAL)
	end

	setFlightAlertVisible(false)
end

local function setInnocentSafetyState(state)
	innocentSafetyEnabled = state
	innocentSkipRequested = false
	airborneSince = nil

	if innocentSafetyEnabled then
		InnocentSafetyToggle.Text = "Innocent safety: ON"
		InnocentSafetyToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 70)

		if not innocentSafetyThread then
			innocentSafetyThread = task.spawn(function()
				runInnocentSafetyLoop()
				innocentSafetyThread = nil
			end)
		end
	else
		InnocentSafetyToggle.Text = "Innocent safety: OFF"
		InnocentSafetyToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 16, 16)
		InnocentGui.Enabled = false
		InnocentIcon.TextTransparency = 0
		setFlightAlertVisible(false)
		innocentActiveEscape = false
		if innocentSafetyThread then
			task.cancel(innocentSafetyThread)
			innocentSafetyThread = nil
		end
	end
end

InnocentSafetyToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setInnocentSafetyState(not innocentSafetyEnabled)
end)
